name: Experimental Methods
description: Experimental analysis: types of measurements and errors; propagation of errors; representation of data; measures of central tendency and dispersion; method of least squares; linear regression. Theory of errors; binomial, Poisson and Gaussian distributions; chi-square test. Dynamic behaviour of instruments: modelling of instruments; first and second order instruments and their response to various inputs. Extension to higher order systems; compensation. Measurement devices: basic elements of a measuring device; transducers and intermediate elements; measurement of various quantities of engineering interest such as displacement, force, torque and power, temperature, pressure, flowrate, etc. Laboratory sessions: carefully planned experiments to illustrate and complement the material discussed in the lectures. Special topics: introduction to design of experiments. Analog to digital converters and data acquisition systems.
